name: weavemx
description: Declarative Multi-agent eXecution for Google Antigravity with sandboxed weave.md manifests, MCP contract enforcement, and a zero-token UI sidecar.
author: Martin Lukasiewycz
suggestedPrompts: Use the weave-authoring skill to create a minimal, single-file (stageless) KidsWiki pipeline for a topic and target age (3-12, default 4). Include two agents: a Writer and a Fact Checker with an in-place revision loop, saving the verified article to article.md in runs/<topic_slug>_age<age>/.
Use the weave-authoring skill to create a 2-stage KidsWiki pipeline with Editorial review and Publishing illustration stages.
